title: CODM Significant Expense Classifier
description: Classifies one candidate segment expense under the significant expense principle that ASU 2023-07 added to ASC 280. Returns whether the expense is separately disclosable under ASC 280-10-50-26A, whether it folds into other segment items under ASC 280-10-50-26B and through which buckets, or whether it sits outside the principle entirely, plus whether ASC 280-10-50-22 separately requires it, the exact paragraphs cited and a plain basis sentence. ASU 2023-07 closes no list of expense category names and states no quantitative significance benchmark, so category name is not an input and significance arrives as a caller declared judgment that this node never computes. The declared domain is 4 booleans x 10 values of the ASC 280-10-50-22 specified item enum, being its 9 live subparagraphs with (i) superseded by ASU 2015-01 plus none, for 160 states, all enumerated. Performs no arithmetic: no ratio, no scale, no threshold compare, no rounding.

included_in_segment_profit_measure.description: True means the expense is included in the reported measure of segment profit or loss. This is the gate ASC 280-10-50-26A opens on, and the only input whose false value places a candidate outside the significant expense principle. Default false.

regularly_provided_to_codm.description: True means the expense is regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker in the segment level information. First limb of ASC 280-10-50-26A. Also the input that decides ASC 280-10-50-26B(a) membership, and one of the two routes into an ASC 280-10-50-22 duty. Default false.

easily_computable_from_codm_information.description: True means the expense amount is easily computable from information regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, for example cost of sales from a revenue amount and a gross margin amount. Second limb of ASC 280-10-50-26A, per ASC 280-10-55-15A and 55-15B. Disjunctive with regularly_provided_to_codm, never a substitute test. Default false.

assessed_significant.description: The entity's own ASC 280-10-50-26A significance judgment, weighing qualitative and quantitative factors. Caller declared. This node computes no benchmark because the Update states none, and the field is deliberately not named as a threshold for that reason. Default false.

specified_item_50_22.description: One of ten closed enum values: none, revenues_from_external_customers, intersegment_revenues, interest_revenue, interest_expense, depreciation_depletion_amortization, unusual_items, equity_in_net_income_of_equity_method_investees, income_tax_expense_or_benefit, significant_noncash_items_other_than_dda. These are the 9 live specified items of ASC 280-10-50-22, subparagraphs (a) through (j) with (i) superseded by ASU 2015-01, plus none. A value outside this set is echoed, flagged as outside the declared domain, and treated as none for disposition. Default none.

mcp_tool_definition.name: classify_codm_expense_significance
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classifies one candidate segment expense under the ASU 2023-07 significant expense principle in ASC 280. Returns must_disclose_separately_50_26A, folds_into_other_segment_items_50_26B with the applicable ASC 280-10-50-26B buckets, outside_significant_expense_principle, separate_disclosure_required_50_22, the paragraphs cited and a basis sentence. Takes the significance assessment as a caller judgment and computes no benchmark, because the Update states none. Performs no arithmetic.

source: authored by DISE-SEG-K-2. The paragraph structure applied here is ASU 2023-07's own amendments to ASC 280, retrieved independently at claim time on 2026-08-15 from https://storage.fasb.org/ASU%202023-07.pdf, HTTP 200, 596371 bytes, pinned at sha256:9f26ab8f95365fb301746f7c75f502815be727c6e12a8d8f72e4ea7a58dc45ea; snapshot at research/clause-snapshots/ASU-2023-07-fasb-DISE-SEG-K-2-2026-08-15.pdf at the workspace root, never inside this repository. Per-kernel spec at research/DISE-SEG-K-2.spec.md, human_sign_off PENDING: enumeration run complete, specification under review. The 7-category expense enum carried as a design placeholder in the parent build spec was NOT adopted: that list is the natural expense category vocabulary of ASU 2024-03, a different Update, and ASU 2023-07 closes no category name list at all, so a 56-state enumeration would have proven a domain the Update does not define. Golden fixtures derive from the Update's own worked examples at ASC 280-10-55-15B, 55-15C, 55-15G, 55-17A, 50-26B(d) and 50-24 per FORMALVERIF-BUILD-SPEC.md section 3d preference 1, not generated from the same clause reading that produced the spec, and each vector's disposition was hand-derived from the clause before generation with generation aborting on disagreement; output_schema derived by running the kernel's own compute() against the vectors in chaingraph/kernels/fixtures/art-634-codm-expense-significance-classifier.fixtures.json.
